title: Gelyn configuration
description: Settings gelyn reads from gelyn.json in the working directory, or from the file given to --config.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema, so that editors offer completion and validation.

Language.description: The language of the generated pages, written to the lang attribute of every document as a BCP 47 tag.

Author.description: The name written to the author meta tag. Omitted from the document when absent.

Description.description: The description written to the description meta tag by any page whose front matter declares none. Omitted from the document when absent.

BaseUrl.description: The absolute http or https URL the site is served from. Its path prefixes every link, and its origin gives each page a canonical URL.

ContentDirectory.description: The directory holding the Markdown sources. Relative values are resolved against the working directory.

OutputDirectory.description: The directory the generated site is written to. Relative values are resolved against the working directory. Existing files are overwritten.
